name: Vehicle Advertising Wrap

yield.notes: Earnings depend on vehicle type, city, mileage driven. Rideshare drivers earn more due to high visibility.

flags: Wrap removal costs if campaign ends
May affect vehicle warranty or lease terms
Minimum mileage requirements in some contracts

prerequisites: Check vehicle lease terms if applicable
startup_checklist: Apply to Carvertise, Wrapify, or Nickelytics
Submit vehicle photos and driving history application
Review contract: campaign duration, minimum miles, removal costs
Schedule wrap installation at approved shop
Track monthly payments and campaign end date
failure_modes: Lease violation if vehicle is under lease
kill_criteria: Campaign ends and no follow-on available
Monthly payment falls below $50 — not worth wrap wear
sources_note: Income ranges from Carvertise and Wrapify published campaign rates.
